name: DevCycle
summary: DevCycle sells feature flags with unlimited seats on every plan. The Free plan allows 1,000 client-side monthly active users. The Business plan is shown as $500 a month billed annually on the plan card but $625 a month in the breakdown, so the price needs confirming with the vendor.

facts.text: Free allows 1,000 client-side monthly active users, 10,000 cloud config requests and 100,000 server config requests a month.
Business includes 100,000 monthly active users, with overage of $2.50 per 1,000 users.
Gradual rollouts take a start percentage and an end percentage on set dates, and multi-step rollouts add percentage milestones.
Server-side SDKs cover NodeJS, NestJS, Go, PHP, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET, with client-side SDKs for JavaScript, React, iOS, Android and others.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: No credit card required. Billing period not specified. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: The plan card shows $500 per month billed annually while the pricing breakdown shows $625 per month, and the page does not explain the difference, so no price is recorded. Currency not named

hiddenCosts: Business overage is $2 per 10,000 cloud config requests, $2 per 100,000 server config requests and $0.50 per 10,000 events.
